title: The instsrv daemon must be disabled on AIX.
check_content:
From the command prompt, execute the following command: 
# grep "^instsrv[[:blank:]]" /etc/inetd.conf

If there is any output from the command, this is a finding.
fixtext:
In "/etc/inetd.conf", comment out the "instsrv" entry by running command: 
# chsubserver -r inetd -C /etc/inetd.conf -d -v 'instsrv' -p 'tcp'

Restart inetd:
# refresh -s inetd
VulnDiscussion: The instsrv service is part of the Network Installation Tools, used for servicing servers running AIX 3.2. This service should be disabled to prevent attacks.
